Every elderly person can be rescued, so nothing is deferred. Deferring costs 50 minutes per elderly person, and each rescue trip costs less than that per person: the Kalika group is a 14-minute round trip for 4 people, and the Trishuli group takes two round trips of 39 minutes each way.

load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-village shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter trishuli-farm
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 trishuli-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter trishuli-farm
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 trishuli-farm shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
</plan>
